children: you need to beat special maps, with different wave structures. They are time limited, so they cannot be obtained after an event ends. After completing an event, you are rewarded with a badge which most of the time connects directly to an unlockable tower. Additionally, beating an event map may also reward you with the respective map badge, if it is available.
